LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_IgnoreFertilityForPre: If enabled, force lovin will always cause pregnancy regardless of fertility.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_EnableSameSexForceLov: Allows using the Force Lovin ability on same-sex targets. May cause special mood interactions.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_RavenFatherDetermines: If enabled, when the father is Raven race, offspring are always eggs regardless of mother's race.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_EnableMalePregnancyEg: If enabled, males will carry and lay eggs whenever one parent is Raven race.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_ForceRavenDescendantD: If enabled, offspring are always Raven race if one parent is Raven.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_EnableEggProjectileMo: Removing spirit eggs becomes a targeted projectile mode. Eggs become non-lethal projectiles.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_DefenseDebugDesc: Shows trigger radius and status when traps are selected.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_FriendlyFireSafeDesc: If enabled, traps skip colonists and allies. If disabled, anyone triggers them.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_DefenseHubRadiusDesc: Maximum distance for defense hub auto-build and maintenance. Default 30 tiles.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_DefenseHubRepairSpeed: Controls auto-repair speed. Higher values repair faster. Default 1.0x.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_OpenPanelHint: Click the button above to open the settings panel. Settings are saved automatically when the window closes.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_AutoSaveHint: Settings are saved automatically when this window closes.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_UpdateNewsMoanSound: Update News Moan Sound (Off by Default)
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_EnableRavenLiquidCove: When disabled, the white slime overlay from Raven Liquid coverage is hidden, but stat penalties and bonuses still apply. Existing coverage is not removed.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_EnableBlackSunCloakVi: Show Black Sun Cloak smoke trail
When disabled, the Black Sun Cloak no longer displays the black smoke particle trail. Shadow Step, attack cooldown, and threat-disabling mechanics are unaffected.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_CentralHubFontScaleDe: Adjusts text in the Sunlit Nexus management terminal from 100% to 125% in 5% steps. The default is 100%; window and button sizes are unchanged.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_CleanupBloodlineHedif: Scan all Raven pawns and remove Wolfein moon/night-strength hediffs that were incorrectly assigned without the bloodline. Use only when anomalies are observed.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_BaseDesc: Base settings for the Raven Race mod.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_AltarDesc: Incubation parameters for the Birth Altar.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_FusangDesc: Fusang organization service and communication parameters.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_IndustryDesc: Raven liquid industry and Sunlit Nexus settings.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_DebugDesc: Developer debug tools. Enabling debug mode unlocks extra features.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_ReproductionDesc: Adjust Raven-specific reproduction behavior, force-lovin parameters, and special interactions with prisoners.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_ComingSoon: This feature will be configurable in a later version...
LanguageData.RavenRace_AbilityTomeLearned: {0} has learned and mastered the "Force Lovin" ability!
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_MiliraFlight_Tooltip: Ravens with Milira bloodline gain true flight ability.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_EnableMiliraFlight_De: If enabled, any Raven with Milira bloodline will automatically gain the flight ability interface.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_MiliraFlight_Note: Note: For true "wall-phasing/deep-water flight", installing [Phoenix Race True Flight Patch] is recommended.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_AutoHandled: Settings will be handled automatically based on character bloodline.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_EnableDimensionalSexD: Allows the masturbator cup to quantum-bind with any target on the map and perform remote forced sex. This is a cheat-tier powerful control feature.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Msg_OxytocinReaction: {0} used oxytocin; their body reacts violently!
LanguageData.RavenRace_Msg_OxytocinNoEffect: Oxytocin has no effect on this creature.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Msg_RapidOvulationBirth: {0} laid an unfertilized spirit egg under pharmaceutical stimulation.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_Settings_Base_Text: Auto-pop up the latest update log on game load
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_Settings_Base_Descrip: When enabled, if the mod has an update note you haven't seen, it will auto-notify on loading a save.
When enabled, all easter egg sounds will load in-game.\nFor detailed independent sound management, adjust it in the [Raven Retro Phonograph] panel.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_Settings_Base_Text_4: Enable random sounds for all lovin' actions
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_Settings_Base_Descrip: When enabled, not only vanilla lovin but also Force Lovin, Mechanical Angel extraction, and other actions have a chance to play goofy lovin' sounds. (Requires the master switch above to be on as well)
When Aegis's lust falls below this value, she will prioritize seeking Raven liquid on the map to feed on, rather than extracting from her master or idling.
When enabled, interactions triggered by attendants will send letter notifications on the right side of the screen.
Show the Golden Feather drop cooldown in the Pawn's inspect panel.
When enabled, tamed Great Ravens will periodically bring back gold items.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_Settings_Base_73f8e4e: Note: If none of the chances trigger, the Great Raven returns empty-handed and notifies.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_Settings_Buildings_De: When enabled, only Ravens within the incense burner's range will lose control to the fragrance and cast "Force Lovin" on nearby opposite-sex (or same-sex) targets.
When enabled, affected pawns are interrupted regardless of what they're doing and immediately go into heat. Off: only triggers when idling.
When enabled, incense-induced heat automatically skips characters below adult development stage.
When enabled, affected pawns will never initiate forced lovin' with their direct relatives.
Higher values make pawns prioritize TV more. At 100x they will almost exclusively watch TV.
When enabled, TV recreation tolerance is always 0; the recreation gained does not decay with repeated use.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_Settings_Buildings_91: Note: With TV AV mode on, when at least two viewers are present simultaneously, lovin' may occur ignoring conditions.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_Settings_Buildings_De: Higher values make pawns prioritize slime baths more. At 100x pawns become bathtub bums.
When enabled, bathtub recreation tolerance is always 0; the recreation gained does not decay with repeated use.
The time two people spend "venting sin" inside the confession booth once they enter.
As long as the bed is connected to a smart mechanical arm, no matter how poor the doctor, the final treatment quality will not fall below this value.
When a surgery fails its roll, a check is made. If the probability below this setting triggers, the mechanical arm forcibly corrects the fatal error, guaranteeing success! (100% means never fails)
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_Settings_Operator_96e: Favor is now automatically linked to the Fusang faction relationship.\n\nZuo Yao's portrait is now fully driven by Live2D; static expression set switching is no longer available.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_Settings_Reproduction: Allow using Force Lovin on mechanoid units. Ordinary mechanoids cannot become pregnant; Aegis can carry a spirit egg while her bionic gestation chamber is intact.
Allow casting Force Lovin at any wall. Walls cannot get pregnant, but if a Raven is the mother, there is a chance of offspring with dense-wall bloodline.
Keeping a spirit egg inside the body warms it; a perfectly warmed spirit egg gains a speed bonus when incubated in a cradle.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_AllowRavenBedSharing: Allow Ravens to ignore cultural precepts and share beds (bed hog)
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_AllowRavenBedSharingD: When enabled, assigning beds: if the bed belongs to a Raven, or the pawn being assigned is a Raven, cultural DLC precepts like "Precept: Premarital sex / Spouse-exclusive" are ignored, and no red prohibition icon appears.
